<?php
class ScopeBase241 { public function capture($value) { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class Scope241 extends ScopeBase241 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $owner->MiSsInG((([new self,"capture"])(...))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG((([new parent,"capture"])(...))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(first:(([new static,"capture"])(...))(true)); } } class ScopeChild241 extends Scope241 { public function capture($value) { echo "CHILD/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class ScopeMagic241 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic241; ScopeChild241::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift241() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase241 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function capture($first,$ignored) { echo "CAPTURE;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope241 extends PacketBase241 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((([new static(7),"capture"])(...))(true,shift241())); } } class PacketChild241 extends PacketScope241 {}
class Owner241 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new Owner241; $child = PacketChild241::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild241 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StopBase241 { public function capture() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "CAPTURE;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class StopScope241 extends StopBase241 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((([new parent,"capture"])(...))(),later241()); } } class StopChild241 extends StopScope241 {}
function later241() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic241 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic241; $result = 0; try { $result = StopChild241::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
